business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description
business_model.claim: TWFG is an independent distribution platform that places personal and commercial insurance with over 300 carriers. It does not keep the underwriting risk of the policies it places.

In some cases, we have underwriting authority for certain carriers, but we do not retain any risk from the policies placed.

business_model.claim: Its direct customers are the agencies on its platform (Branches and MGA Agencies), which it serves with technology, training and carrier access. The end clients are the insurance buyers those agencies serve.
quotes: Our business model, developed by agents for agents, serves over 3,000 TWFG Agencies and offers a differentiated level of autonomy and entrepreneurial opportunity.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 and the 10-K MD&A revenue table
business_model.claim: The company operates through two offerings: Insurance Services (Agency-in-a-Box plus Corporate Branches) and TWFG MGA. In 2025 these were 79% and 20% of revenue.

Insurance Services (79% of 2025 Revenue)
TWFG MGA (20% of 2025 Revenue)

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A revenue table and text

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and income statement

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K Item 1 and MD&A
business_model.claim: Commission income is a percentage of the premium placed. Rates are set by carriers and typically range from 7% to 30%, with a 2025 average of about 12.8%. Revenue therefore moves with premium volume and carrier pricing.
quotes: Commission rates vary by carrier, state, and business line, typically ranging from 7% to 30%, with an average of about 12.8% and 12% as of December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively.

business_model.claim: TWFG collects all commission revenue and passes a share to Branches and MGA Agencies as commission expense, so their operating costs stay with them. For Corporate Branches it keeps all commission income and carries their expenses.
quotes: Instead, we receive all commission revenue and subsequently pay and record a commission expense to each Branch based on the relevant exclusive Branch agreement.
we retain 100% of the commission income received from insurance carriers
